title: Chapter 583 - 583 Wolf; Heavenly Hound!
content:
Chapter 583 - 583 Wolf; Heavenly Hound!

Chapter 583 - 583 Wolf; Heavenly Hound!

583 Wolf; Heavenly Hound!

Lin Fan was familiar with the place and found some dry wood.

Then, he smeared the two big rabbits with cumin powder, pepper powder, chili powder, and other seasonings before placing them on the fire.

He flipped and cut the meat.

The fragrant oil was dripping.

Not long after, a rich fragrance spread through the forest.

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Indifference of the World: [It’s starting, it’s starting. Today’s eating broadcast program is starting again.]

Goodnight: [I can make an extra bowl of white rice by watching God Lin’s food broadcast every day. I won’t say anything more. Let’s go!]

Confucius Said: [Even just looking at it from afar, I know that the taste of this rabbit meat would definitely be superb.]

…

Lin Fan tore off a large rabbit leg and started eating.

It was crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. It was extremely delicious.

Lin Fan ate to his heart’s content.

The size of the rabbit was simply too big.

Lin Fan had only eaten half of it and his stomach was already starting to swell up.

At this moment, a sound came from the grass not far away.

Then, a fierce beast with silver fur, sharp teeth, and a wolf-like appearance slowly walked out. It was about one meter tall.

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Model: [F*ck! Is this a wolf? What a big wolf!]

Jing Tian: [Wolves usually live in groups. Could God Lin have encountered a wolf pack?]

Flowing Years: [Don’t worry, they’re just wolves. God Lin can casually wave his sword and kill them easily.]

Golden Dragon Chasing the Sun: [But did God Lin notice it?]

Clear: [God Lin, quickly turn around!]

…

Lin Fan seemed to have read the comments in the live broadcast room.

He slowly turned around and looked at the wolf, which was staring at the roasted rabbit with a pair of faintly sparkling eyes. Its mouth was half-open, and its could not stop drooling.

“Do you want to eat?” he asked with a smile.

The wolf was slightly stunned.

That was because it realized that it understood Lin Fan’s words.

What was going on?

It opened its mouth and gave a soft call.

“Are you a dog too?”

Lin Fan’s face darkened.

This was actually a dog?

Moreover, why were dogs always so weird, asking others if they were dogs?

“I’m a human.”

The big white dog sized Lin Fan up again as if it was digesting this sentence.

At this moment, the rich aroma of roasted rabbit wafted into its nose again.

It could not help but inhale hard with its nose. It put all its attention back on the roasted rabbit. It opened its mouth and allowed its saliva to stop it from flowing down.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan could not help but smile as he pulled off a rabbit leg. “Eat.”

As he spoke, he casually threw it out.

The big white dog’s reaction was extremely agile. It opened its mouth and bit the rabbit’s leg.

After swallowing the rabbit leg, the big white dog’s eyes instantly lit up.

“Delicious!” he praised.

Its tail could not help but wag.

Obviously, it was very happy.

Lin Fan smiled. “If it’s delicious, then eat more.”

After all, he could not eat so much. It would be a waste to just keep it.

Thus, Lin Fan tore off another rabbit leg.

After the big white dog finished eating, Lin Fan directly threw out the remaining rabbit meat.

The big white dog ate happily, wagging its tail even more happily.

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Ruffian: [He gave away such delicious rabbit meat just like that?]

Quiet Rabbit: [God Lin wasted it. Wouldn’t it be better if he gave it to me?]

Memories of Those Years: [I can’t help but want to fight for food with the wolves.]

Wind: [God Lin gave so much meat to the wolf. What if it attacks God Lin later? This is a little risky.]

Power: [If the wolf attacks God Lin, it’ll only take one sword strike from God Lin. At that time, God Lin should be able to eat the wolf meat.]

…

Everyone had experienced Lin Fan’s strength for themselves.

Not to mention a one-meter-tall wolf, even a ten-meter-long crocodile could be easily killed.

Not long after, the two rabbits were completely eaten.

The white dog was still wagging its tail.

“Do you have a name?” asked Lin Fan.

“Heavenly Hound!”

“Heavenly Hound?” Lin Fan nodded. “The name is not bad.”

Then, he raised his head and looked at the moon that was gradually hanging in the sky. He was entranced.

Perhaps, the dog was attracted by Lin Fan.

The Heavenly Hound looked in the direction Lin Fan was looking at.

The man and the dog looked at the sky quietly.

It was quiet and peaceful.

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Who Am I Crazy For: [The rabbit meat has been eaten up.]

Big Saber King Five: [Isn’t this a wolf? Why is it called the Heavenly Dog?]

Unhindered Rain: [Why do I feel like God Lin was talking to this wolf just now?]]

Unique: [God Lin has the power of a supreme god. It seems normal for him to talk to animals.]

Rainy Day: [God Lin, Heavenly Hound, moon, forest… I feel that this scene is so beautiful!]

I’m a Big Boss: [I want to use this image as my screensaver!]

Cyan: [I want it to be my screensaver too!]

…

As a result, many people used the scene as their screensaver for their computers and cell phones.

The night gradually deepened.

Lin Fan stood up and drew a circle around him.

[Skill: Draw a Circle For Home]

Immediately, the sound of the wind, the chirping of birds in the distance, and the flying dust… were all isolated outside.

Then, Lin Fan took out his LV sleeping bag and fell asleep.

After a while, he began to snore.

The Heavenly Hound looked curiously at Lin Fan, who was in his sleeping bag.

He walked around in circles as if he was hesitating about something.

In the end, he slowly lay on the ground.

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Ruthless: [F*ck! God Lin is sleeping? The Heavenly Hound is still beside him.]

Adorable Bookworm: [Does God Lin treat the Heavenly Hound as an ordinary dog? This is too careless of him.]

Crying Fish: [I hope the Heavenly Hound won’t hurt God Lin. He gave it a lot of food just now.]

Terence: [No, I have to watch God Lin sleep today. If anything happens, I have to remind him immediately.]

Asians: I want to watch God Lin sleep too.]

…

The number of people online would decrease significantly at night.

After all, everyone needed to rest.

However, tonight, even though it was nighttime, the number of people online did not decrease at all.

In fact, it even seemed to be rising.

…

In the blink of an eye, it was the second day.

Sunlight shone through the cracks of the trees and onto the ground. It was like specks of starlight, incomparably dazzling.

Lin Fan slowly opened his eyes and crawled out of his sleeping bag.

When he saw the Heavenly Hound lying on the ground not far away, a faint smile appeared on his face.

“Are you hungry?”

The Heavenly Hound raised its head slowly and looked at Lin Fan quietly.

At this moment, its silence was an answer.

Lin Fan smiled and took out some leftover bird meat from the day before. “Try this.”

As he spoke, he casually threw the meat to it.

The Heavenly Hound reacted quickly and climbed up.

Then, it began to feast.
